ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Oct-02-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Present: Commissioner Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Maureen Howard. Ms. Heng May Tu, Cantonese Interpreter was sworn for the petitioner. Petitioner Shu Ling Zhang was sworn and examined. The court signed the Decree changing the name to Elaine Shu Ling Cheung.
